# Lionel Fairlie

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027), [v5 c13 P31](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Agnes  <sub>[v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027), [v5 c13 P31](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027), [v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029), [v5 c16 P38](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Lionel is a tall, broad-shouldered, handsome, and colossus-like man of middle age. He has a prominent Roman nose, frank gray eyes that can flash with fire, and a high, smooth, pale forehead. He possesses a thick mane of red hair and a long, flowing red beard that falls over his broad chest.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027), [v5 c16 P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027)_

## Personality

Lionel is a blustering, hot-tempered, and stubborn man who loves having his own way, yet he can be exceedingly charming, generous, and jovial. He possesses a boisterous, roaring sense of humor and appreciates spirit, intelligence, and grit in others. Though he is an outspoken, loud-voiced free-thinker who enjoys provoking others, he is fundamentally open-handed and incapable of malice or pettiness.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P22](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0022), [v4 c9 P48](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0048), [v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c6 P22](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0022), [v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c16 P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059), [v5 c16 P77](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0077)_

## Abilities

- Skilled at farming and animal husbandry  <sub>[v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027)</sub>
- Lively debater and conversationalist  <sub>[v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027), [v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry his youth sweetheart, Harriet Ainslie  <sub>[v5 c14 P39](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0039), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c22 P11](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0011)</sub>
- To support the Glen St. Agnes church on his own terms  <sub>[v5 c16 P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059)</sub>

## History

In his youth, Lionel Fairlie courted Harriet Ainslie, but after a sudden quarrel, he married Dinah Coyle out of resentment. Following a dispute with a church session member over a cow deal, he ceased attending church for two decades, though he eventually resumed attending when Mr. Ashdown became the minister. After spotting Harriet Ainslie again at church, his feelings for her were rekindled, prompting him to pursue her anew. When young Grace Ashdown confronted him over his behavior toward the church and community, Lionel was so impressed by her spirit that he agreed to resume his financial contributions to the minister's salary and attend services regularly. He eventually persuaded Harriet Ainslie to release herself from a youth vow, leading to their marriage alongside Harriet's sister Clementine and Mr. Ashdown.

_Sources: [v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027), [v5 c13 P30](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0030), [v5 c14 P39](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0039), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c16 P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c22 P11](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0011), [v5 c25 P0](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Courted Harriet Ainslie in his youth before a bitter quarrel led to their separation  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v5 c13 P30](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0030)</sub>

## Quotes

> I suppose you’ll have to excuse me, ladies. I’m a little busy . . . getting ready to bake a cake as it were.  <sub>[v5 c6 P35](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0035)</sub>

> There is no need to be frightened. It’s only a day in a person's life, and a day passes soon enough.  <sub>[v5 c16 P15](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0015)</sub>

> You are a very small girl to be carrying so much trouble.  <sub>[v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029)</sub>

> I swear you possess grit, despite everything—grit appeals to me. Here, take a seat—take a seat!  <sub>[v5 c16 P55](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0055)</sub>

> Look right here, girl, should you shake my hand and share a meal with me, I am going to pay the amount I formerly did toward the salary, and I am going to attend church on the initial Sunday of each month...  <sub>[v5 c16 P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059)</sub>
